// RED-PROBE for clamped-text-reachability's enumerator (V2-P3-01).
// The extractor must count: truncate ×2, line-clamp-2 ×1 — and nothing else.
import Link from "next/link"

export function ClampProbe({ name, blurb }: { name: string; blurb: string }) {
    // this commented clamp must NOT count: className="truncate line-clamp-2"
    /* nor this one: line-clamp-3 truncate */
    const untruncated = "the word 'untruncated' must not match the clamp token (word boundary)"
    return (
        <Link href="/somewhere" className="block">
            <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold">{name}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-xs">{blurb}</p>
            <p className="truncate text-xs">{untruncated}</p>
        </Link>
    )
}
